title: Group
description: Represents an Azure AD group. Groups are collections of principals with shared access to resources. Microsoft Graph supports several types of groups: Microsoft 365 groups, security groups, and mail-enabled security groups.

classification.description: Classification for the group (e.g., low, medium, high business impact).

createdDateTime.description: Timestamp of when the group was created.

description.description: An optional description for the group.

displayName.description: The display name for the group. Required on creation.

expirationDateTime.description: Timestamp of when the group is set to expire.

groupTypes.description: Specifies the group type. Include Unified for Microsoft 365 groups. Include DynamicMembership for dynamic groups.

isAssignableToRole.description: Indicates whether this group can be assigned to an Azure AD role. Can only be set at creation time.

mail.description: The SMTP address for the group.

mailEnabled.description: Specifies whether the group is mail-enabled. Required on creation.

mailNickname.description: The mail alias for the group, unique for Microsoft 365 groups. Required on creation.

membershipRule.description: The rule that determines members for a dynamic group.

membershipRuleProcessingState.description: Indicates whether the dynamic membership processing is on or paused. On or Paused.

preferredLanguage.description: The preferred language for a Microsoft 365 group in ISO 639-1 format.

renewedDateTime.description: Timestamp of when the group was last renewed.

securityEnabled.description: Specifies whether the group is a security group. Required on creation.

visibility.description: Specifies the group join policy and group content visibility. Public, Private, or HiddenMembership.
